description:
[Reports] List custom reports you can open (yours, shared with you) and the JobMojito templates, with id, title, visibility, your access and version.

Custom reports you can open on this account (yours, the ones shared with you) and the JobMojito templates. Pinned first, then most recently updated.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

scope.description: all (default), mine, shared (by colleagues) or templates.

name: list_reports

visibility.description: private (only the owner), merchant (everyone at the company), people (chosen people), template (JobMojito template).

title: List custom reports
